widgets.help: Enable widgets to show them on the dashboard. Click to select a widget, then drag to move or resize from corners.
widgets.buttonAboveToLoad: button above to load the list of plugins available for installation.

plugins.settingsHelp: Configure each installed plugin below. Enable them, set transparency, refresh intervals, and assign to tabs just like core widgets.
plugins.perDevice: Per device — applies to the device you're editing from

devices.manageHelp: Manage devices and copy tabs/widget settings between them. Copying will overwrite the current device tabs and widget assignments.
devices.copyExplain: This action will COPY all tabs and widget settings from the selected device to this current client.
devices.copyWarning: This will overwrite all current tabs and widget assignments.

colors.heading: Accent Colors
colors.help: Background color applies to light mode only. Accent color is used throughout the dashboard for highlights and interactive elements.

screensaver.heading: Screensaver
screensaver.help: The screensaver activates after a period of inactivity, cycling through tabs or displaying a photo slideshow.
screensaver.cycleTabsDisabled: Create tabs in the Tab Bar to enable this feature
screensaver.immichDisabled: Configure an Immich photo source in the Photos widget to enable this feature

vacation.heading: Vacation Mode
vacation.help: While on vacation, chore due-time chimes are muted and the screensaver becomes a fun vacation animation. Settings apply to this display and persist until you turn vacation mode off.
vacation.muteSounds: Mute chore sounds while on vacation
vacation.dateHelp: With dates set, vacation starts and ends automatically, missed-chore tracking pauses for those days, and streaks bridge across them permanently. Without dates, vacation stays on until you turn it off.

autoDark.heading: Daylight Auto Dark Mode
autoDark.help: To enable auto mode: save an OpenWeather API key in Connections, enter a location here, save this section, then press the bottom-bar theme button until the half sun/half moon icon appears.
autoDark.locationHelp: Examples: Dallas,TX,US, London,UK, or ZIP code like 76034

users.avatarHelp: Optional — pick from the built-in set, or upload a photo after adding.

chores.dailyRewardHelp: Clams awarded when a user completes all their daily chores
chores.celebrationEnable: Celebrate when someone finishes every chore
chores.celebrationHelp: Shows confetti on every display when a user completes their last chore of the day.
chores.soundsEnable: Enable chore due-time sounds (household-wide master switch)
chores.defaultSoundHelp: Default sound (used when a chore doesn't pick its own)
chores.noChoresForUser: No chores assigned to this user.

prizes.name: Prize Name
prizes.repeatableTooltip: A repeatable prize stays on the store shelf after redemption instead of being consumed
prizes.repeatableLabel: Repeatable (can be redeemed more than once)
prizes.repeatableShortTooltip: A repeatable prize stays on the store shelf after redemption
prizes.storeHelp: One-time offers kids can request on the dashboard; approve requests there (PIN-gated when set)
prizes.storeEmpty: The store is empty. Use ➕ next to a prize above to stock it.
prizes.requestedBy: Requested by {{name}} — approve or decline on the dashboard
prizes.addToStoreRepeatable: Add to store (stays on the shelf after each redemption)
prizes.declineAndRemove: Decline request and remove from store

security.heading: Security Settings
security.help: The admin PIN is required to access the admin panel. Keep your PIN secure and memorable.
security.changeNote: Changing your PIN will require you to use the new PIN on your next admin panel access.

connections.heading: Connections
connections.openWeatherHelp: Get your free API key from openweathermap.org/api
connections.openWeatherStoredHelp: A key is saved. Leave blank to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
connections.proxyHelp: Domains allowed for proxy requests (e.g., api.example.com, another-api.com)
connections.homeAssistantHelp: Connect Home Assistant to use it as your weather source instead of an OpenWeatherMap key. The access token stays on the server and is never sent to a display.
connections.homeAssistantUrlHelp: The address you use to reach Home Assistant, including the port.
connections.homeAssistantTokenHelp: Create one in Home Assistant under your profile, at the bottom of the Security tab.
connections.homeAssistantTokenStoredHelp: A token is saved. Leave blank to keep it, or paste a new one to replace it.
connections.homeAssistantEntityHelp: Usually weather.home. Use Test Connection to pick from a list.
connections.encryptionRequired: Set an encryption key on the server before saving a Home Assistant token.

about.heading: About
about.help: This tab shows build metadata for the running client and server plus any Git tags that point to each commit.
